# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Titles:** Class beauty and belle  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Philippa  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Phil Blake  <sub>[v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa possesses beauty and charm with brown tints, big brown eyes, and curls. She looks particularly suited to creamy yellow silk and lace dresses. After having babies, she grew fearfully thin, though she noted her husband liked it as there was less contrast between them.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 c27 P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Personality

Philippa is frivolous, playful, and charming, with a thoughtless yet unselfish and loyal disposition. Though indecisive and self-described as a 'see-saw', she has ample brains and is capable of ready small talk. She views boys as good chums and loves being popular without being snobbish.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c10 P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 c19 P22](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0022), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

## History

Philippa Gordon met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant at Redmond College and quickly became close chums with them. Coming from a rich, exclusive Bluenose family in Bolingbroke, her beauty and popularity opened doors for her friends across Redmond's social life. She struggled to choose between her suitors Alec and Alonzo until spending time at Prospect Point, where she fell in love with a minister named Jonas. She moved into Patty's Place with Anne, Priscilla, Stella, and Aunt Jamesina, learning household tasks while excelling in her studies. Despite initial resistance from her mother, she stood firm and married Jonas in June after graduating, eventually having children. Later, she advised Gilbert Blythe by letter that Anne was not engaged to Roy Gardner, encouraging him to try again.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c7 P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 c10 P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059), [v3 c16 P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_
